user_story: As a user, I want to manage my data in an editable web table by adding, editing, and deleting records so that I can maintain an up-to-date list of information. Acceptance Criteria: I can click the button with id 'addNewRecordButton' to add a new record. After adding a record, the record should appear in the table. I can edit an existing record by interacting with the respective row in the table. I can delete a record and it should no longer be visible in the table.
